action.text: Implementing unnamed-section feature. Done: UNNAMED_SECTION sentinel, UnnamedSectionDisabledError, __all__ entries, __init__ param, RawConfigParser.add_section, read_dict (preserve sentinel). Next patches: 1) ConfigParser.add_section (skip validation for sentinel), 2) _read (route headerless options), 3) write (emit unnamed options before headers). Then: test file, docs.

action.new:
def add_section(self, section):
        """Create a new section in the configuration.  Extends
        RawConfigParser.add_section by validating if the section name is
        a string."""
        if section is not UNNAMED_SECTION:
            self._validate_value_types(section=section)
        super().add_section(section)
